input.free_text_description: The system operates in the social media, content management domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include activity, collect, comment. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to comment on posts, so that I can participate in discussions and provide feedback.
As a API Consumer, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a API Consumer, I want to receive notifications about relevant activity, so that I stay informed about updates that matter to me.
As a API Consumer, I want to create and browse posts, so that I can share content and discover what others have published.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
